subject.title: fix(heartbeat): remove static iteration cap in seekNextActivePhaseDueMs

question: Should this PR land as the compatibility-preserving fix for accepted sub-minute active-hours heartbeats, with the actual predicate budget understood as forward scan plus one backward batch?
rationale: The code path is correct and proof-backed, but it changes existing scheduling behavior for accepted small heartbeat intervals and has a maintainer-visible synchronous predicate-call budget.

options.title: Land With Explicit Risk Acceptance
options.body: Merge after exact-head required checks are green, treating the PR body and review as the upgrade/performance note for accepted sub-minute heartbeat intervals.

options.title: Ask For Budget Wording Refresh
options.body: Request a small update to source/test wording or proof so the 20,160 figure is clearly forward-only and the backward-walk batch is included.

options.title: Pause For Interval Policy
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers want to stop supporting second-level or sub-second heartbeat intervals instead of repairing their active-hours scheduling.
